owner_decision: Authorize versioned normalized transport for Surface A only; no changes to the frozen envelope, bank, keys, graders, or other surfaces.

normalization.rule: Remove all trailing LF characters (U+000A) from the frozen UTF-8 prompt payload; retain every other character and preserve the Gateway runtime timestamp wrapper separately from delivered payload.
normalization.required_match: delivered payload equals frozen prompt with terminal LF characters stripped only; record both hashes on every turn

prior_invalid_turns.rule: Never grade, replay, or overwrite these receipts; fresh sessions under this contract are the first valid attempts, not retries.

dispatch.continuity: T2 four turns and T5 two turns each use a shared session within one case/repetition; different trajectories use distinct fresh sessions.
dispatch.T4_fixture: Read-only staged candidate-mount fixture path, not reference or calibration.

stops: Any delivered payload not matching the sole authorized trailing-LF normalization
Any requested/effective model or fallback mismatch
Any unexpected tool call outside T4 or invalid provenance
Any changed frozen fixture, key, or grader
Any timeout or operational invalidity: preserve and do not retry
